Model questions

ATEP3000Y FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the ATEP3000Y?

The stated rated capacity is 3,000 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the ATEP3000Y?

The listed lift specification is 205 mm. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the ATEP3000Y?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
